title: LeftBlock identity and Data Parade donation
description: LeftBlock is the final name. Canonical source is checkpointed locally at e3934c90bedec7fbaa137f62c6e0503ba708ed9b with legacy Pudicus compatibility retained; local installation and verification are complete across 137 eligible repositories.
